title: Internal Sales Coordinator
description:
Internal Sales Coordinator

26k-28k

Are you organised, customer-focused and confident building relationships? We're looking for an Internal Sales Coordinator to join a successful business in Brighton.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys generating new business, supporting the sales process and helping to drive business growth in a professional and collaborative environment. The role offers a balance of customer service, sales support and account coordination, without the pressure of a heavily target-driven sales position.

What You'll Be Doing:
- Generating new business through indsutry research
- Ensuring data and contacts are correct and up to date
- Working closely with the Director to highlight potential new client leads
- Building and maintaining strong relationships with existing customers
- Identifying opportunities to maximise sales within existing accounts
- Maintaining accurate customer records within the CRM system
- Supporting the wider sales team with administration and reporting

What We're Looking For:
- Previous experience in internal sales, sales support, customer service or account coordination
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills
- A proactive approach and willingness to support commercial objectives
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail
- Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a busy environment
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office and CRM systems
- A positive attitude and strong team ethic

What's On Offer:
- Competitive basic salary
- Ongoing training and development
- Clear progression opportunities
- Friendly and supportive team culture
- Modern office environment

If you're looking for a role that combines customer interaction, sales support and relationship management within a welcoming and collaborative business, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Optical call centre assistant
description:
Optical Call Centre Advisor - BrightonAbout Lunaria Recruitment

Lunaria Recruitment is a specialist recruitment agency dedicated to the optical sector. We work with independent and high-profile optical businesses across the UK, connecting talented optical professionals with great career opportunities.

We are currently recruiting for an Optical Call Centre Advisor to join a friendly and professional team in Brighton.

The Role

We are looking for a confident, friendly and customer-focused person to join an optical call centre team. You will be the first point of contact for patients and customers, providing excellent service and helping to ensure every enquiry is handled professionally.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Answering incoming calls from patients and customers
- Booking and arranging appointments
- Responding to customer queries and providing accurate information
- Making outbound calls where required
- Managing appointment changes and cancellations
- Updating customer and patient records accurately
- Liaising with optical practices and internal teams
- Providing a professional and friendly customer experience
- Handling a busy call environment while maintaining excellent service levels

About You

We are looking for someone who is:
- Confident and professional on the telephone
- Friendly, approachable and customer-focused
- Well organised with excellent attention to detail
- Comfortable working in a busy environment
- A strong communicator
- Computer literate and confident using different systems
- Reliable, positive and able to work well as part of a team

Previous optical experience is desirable but not essential. Experience within a call centre, customer service, healthcare or appointment-booking environment would be highly beneficial.

The Opportunity

This is a great opportunity to join a growing optical team in Brighton, with the chance to develop your customer service and optical knowledge within a professional environment.

Location: Brighton

Position: Optical Call Centre Advisor

Hours: Full Time

Salary: Competitive, depending on experience

Start Date: ASAP

Apply Today

If you are looking for your next customer service opportunity and would love to build a career within the optical sector, get in touch with Lunaria Recruitment today.

We would love to hear from you and can discuss the role and next steps in confidence.

title: PCN Office Administrator
company: East and Central Brighton Primary Care Network
advertiser_name: East and Central Brighton Primary Care Network
description: East & Central Brighton PCN are seeking an experienced and highly organised Office Administrator to provide operational, administrative, workforce and governance support across the PCN. What We Offer NHS Pension Scheme. Generous annual leave entitlement. Training and development opportunities. Flexible and supportive working arrangements. The opportunity to contribute to improving healthcare services for local communities across Brighton. This is an exciting opportunity for an individual with strong organisational and people skills who enjoys working in a fast-paced healthcare environment and supporting service development.The Office Administrator will be responsible for the smooth day-to-day running of the PCN office environment and administrative functions. The post holder will coordinate office systems, workforce administration, recruitment processes, governance requirements and staff support activities, contributing to a well-managed and compliant organisation. Main Responsibilities Office and Facilities Management Oversee the day-to-day operation of PCN office facilities, ensuring they are safe, organised and welcoming. Manage room bookings and coordinate the use of administrative spaces. Liaise with premises providers and contractors regarding maintenance, repairs and service issues. Order and manage office supplies, equipment and resources. Maintain equipment inventories and coordinate servicing, testing and maintenance schedules. Support compliance with health and safety requirements, including fire safety, risk assessments and first aid arrangements. Workforce and HR Administration Coordinate recruitment processes, including advertising vacancies, arranging interviews and issuing correspondence. Assist with onboarding new staff, preparing offer documentation, induction packs and access requests. Support pre-employment checks, including DBS applications, right-to-work checks, references and employment compliance requirements. Maintain accurate and confidential staff records in line with GDPR, employment legislation and CQC requirements. Monitor annual leave, sickness absence and workforce records, escalating issues where appropriate. Maintain records relating to mandatory training, professional registration, occupational health and staff vaccinations. Support workforce planning, staff wellbeing initiatives and learning and development activities. Assist with the development and maintenance of an annual PCN training programme. Governance and Compliance Support compliance with CQC standards and PCN governance requirements. Maintain policy, procedure and operational documentation, ensuring version control and accessibility. Assist with internal and external audits and provide evidence and documentation as required. Ensure information governance, confidentiality and data protection requirements are adhered to at all times. Support the implementation and review of policies and procedures across the organisation. Administrative and Operational Support Organise and minute Board meetings, leadership meetings and other PCN forums. Manage PCN-wide communications, ensuring information is shared effectively with practices and staff. Process staff expense claims and maintain associated records. Act as a key point of contact for PCN staff, practices and external stakeholders. Provide administrative support to service developments, projects and operational initiatives. Provide support covering reception at our weekly Health Hub. Service Support and Improvement Work with clinical and operational colleagues to support the smooth delivery of PCN clinics. Coordinate resources, space and equipment to support efficient service delivery. Identify opportunities to improve administrative systems, processes and staff experience. Contribute to service improvement projects and the development of efficient ways of working.

title: Receptionist (Bank)
description: This is an exciting opportunity to work as a receptionist at a GP practice covering sessions for scheduled holidays, sickness and other adhoc requests. The purpose of the role is to: Receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate appointments, service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way Offer general assistance to the Practice and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone Undertake a variety of administrative duties to assist in the smooth running of the Practice. Facilitate effective communication between patients, members the primary health care team, secondary care and other associated healthcare agencies We are looking for a positive and enthusiastic receptionist to join our established and hard working team. The role requires someone who is diligent, friendly and capable, someone who is self motivated, a good communicator and always striving for the best for the patients. Ideally the candidate will have experience of working in a reception environment within a healthcare setting but this is not essential as on-the-job training will be provided. Exceptional candidates without healthcare experience but with a strong and relevant background will also be considered. JOB TITLE: Receptionist REPORTS TO: Practice Manager HOURS: Morning sessions run from 07:45am until 12:45pm and afternoon sessions run from 13:45pm until 18:45pm. Job Summary: Offer general assistance to the Practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone Undertake a variety of administrative duties to assist in the smooth running of the Practice including the provision of clerical support to clinical staff and other members of the Practice team Duties and Responsibilities: The duties and responsibilities to be undertaken by members of the Practice reception team are defined in the job description and may be varied from time to time under the direction of the Practice Manager, dependent on current and evolving practice workload and staffing levels.

title: Membership & Events Coordinator - Immediate Start
description:
Membership & Events Coordinator - Immediate Start

Location: Hove, East Sussex
Salary: 15 - 17 p/h (DOE) PAYE
Job Type: Part-Time, 2 Days per Week
Working Pattern: Office-based

The Role

As a Membership & Events Coordinator, you will play a key role in the day-to-day management of the association, ensuring members receive excellent support while helping to increase engagement, membership growth, and industry participation.

This is a varied and rewarding position combining administration, relationship management, event coordination, communications, and business development. It would suit someone who enjoys building professional relationships, taking ownership of projects, and working as part of a collaborative team.

Key Responsibilities:

Membership Management
- Maintain accurate membership records and manage renewal processes.
- Act as the first point of contact for member enquiries.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective members.
- Support initiatives aimed at growing membership and increasing member engagement.

Events & Member Engagement
- Coordinate online events, webinars, and member engagement activities.
- Research and identify relevant speakers and industry topics.
- Manage event communications, registrations, and follow-up activities.
- Arrange committee meetings and prepare supporting documentation.
- Support regular member communications and updates.

Business Development & Partnerships
- Identify and engage with potential industry partners, suppliers, and sponsors.
- Build relationships with external stakeholders to support membership growth.
- Assist with initiatives designed to increase engagement and commercial opportunities.

Administration & Communications
- Update website content, news articles, and member information.
- Monitor industry developments and identify topics relevant to members.
- Support the delivery of member services and communications.
- Maintain accurate records and ensure the smooth administration of the association.

Skills and Experience

Essential
- Previous experience within membership services, events, legal, recruitment is ideal.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- Strong organisational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
- Confidence interacting with professionals and senior stakeholders.
- Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office applications.

Person Specification

The successful candidate will be highly organised, proactive, and personable. You will enjoy building relationships, managing varied workloads, and working collaboratively to deliver an excellent experience for members and stakeholders. You will be comfortable taking ownership of projects and confident communicating with individuals at all levels.

title: Reception Administrator
description: We are a large NHS Mental Health Trust in South East England. We're looking for people to help us provide high quality services for the patients, carers and local communities we serve. We want patients and staff to recommend our organisation as a place where they would be happy for their friends and family to be treated. You can help us do this by bringing your skills, experience and commitment to Sussex Partnership. We are looking for an enthusiastic, self-motivated and experienced part time receptionist. You will be based to work at Hove Polyclinic, First floor on the Millview Hospital site in Nevill Avenue, Hove. The post holder will look forward to a varied and rewarding work environment, in which finding a balance between team working and utilising initiative is important. You will need the ability to foster positive working relationships & in return be an essential part of the team. The post holder will be motivated and able to organise their workload, demonstrate a professional face to face and telephone manner, and be able to liaise effectively with other agencies and members of the public. The successful candidate will provide reception duties (checking in clients, taking in deliveries, liaising with team staff, booking rooms, taking calls etc) and general office tasks to support the admin team. An ability to deal sensitively with people who may be distressed at times is also essential. To deal with all incoming telephone calls and sign post as required To ensure post both internal and external is sent to the correct staff/team To be responsible for locking up at the end of the day To deal with all room booking requests via a generic inbox and booking resource scheduler system To support the wider team with duties such as Uploading Calling service users to advise prescriptions are ready for collection Photocopying see job description for further information
